entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, David. I'm trying to return something, a helmet, but the website is just so confusing. I don't know what to do.
I can certainly help you look into that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, no, nothing's broken. It was a gift, and the color is just... wrong. My son won't wear it. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it. I'm just so overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can definitely help sort this out for you. It's no problem at all. Do you have the order number handy?
I think so... hold on. Yes, it's VF886-02-114.
Great, thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Apex Trail helmet. It looks like it was delivered about 52 days ago.
Is that bad? I saw so many different rules online, I got worried. I just want to get him the right color.
Not at all. Since it's a standard VeloFit helmet and not a special electronic item, our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. You're well within that timeframe.
Oh, really? So I can return it?

Absolutely. And because you've kept the box unopened, we know the helmet's safety integrity is perfectly preserved. I've just approved the return in our system. I'm sending the pre-paid shipping label to the email on file right now. You should receive it in the next few minutes.
Oh, thank you! That's such a relief. You've been so much more helpful than the website. Thank you, David.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day and happy holidays!
